title: stream.export response
description: Export stream transfers or packet data from an explicit full or range base-cache scope.
x-description-zh: 从显式 full 或 range 基础分析缓存范围导出 stream 查询结果。
x-output_notes: stream.export 成功响应的 summary 字段为 summary.analysis_complete, summary.clock, summary.clock_edges, summary.complete_packet_count, summary.control_xz_count, summary.data_xz_count, summary.edge, summary.first_stall_time, summary.first_transfer_time, summary.handshake, summary.kind, summary.last_stall_time, summary.last_transfer_time, summary.line_limit, summary.output, summary.output_written, summary.packet_count_status, summary.packet_enabled, summary.packet_stable_mismatch_count, summary.partial_packet_count, summary.ready_bp_conflict_count, summary.requested_range, summary.response_truncated, summary.returned_count, summary.row_count, summary.sample_point, summary.sample_time_semantics, summary.sampling_mode, summary.scan_complete, summary.scanned_range, summary.stall_cycles, summary.stall_windows, summary.status, summary.stream, summary.total_count, summary.transfer_count, summary.truncation_scopes, summary.value_width_complete, summary.vld_cycles, summary.width_diagnostics；data 字段为 data.preview。未知字段会被拒绝。完整性和裁剪事实使用 summary.scan_complete, summary.analysis_complete, summary.response_truncated, summary.total_count, summary.returned_count, summary.truncation_scopes。

jsonObject.description: 显式动态键 JSON 对象；每个 value 仍受 jsonValue 递归合同约束。

signal.description: One-bit final waveform signal path used as reset.

polarity.description: Level that asserts reset. X, Z, and unavailable samples are conservatively treated as asserted.

reset.description: Reset definition. Both signal and polarity are required when reset is supplied.

nonSamplingStreamFieldMap.description: Caller-defined stream field to a canonical logic-value object.
